﻿using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;

namespace WebApp.DTOs
{
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    //  DTOs para RECIBIR datos de la API (para mostrar en el formulario)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------

    /// <summary>
    /// DTO para recibir los detalles completos de UNA receta. Incluye los pasos.
    /// Usado en la página de edición para poblar el formulario.
    /// </summary>
    public class RecipeResponseDTO
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }
        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string Status { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string AuthorName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public ICollection<RecipeStepResponseDTO> Steps { get; set; } = new List<RecipeStepResponseDTO>();
        public ICollection<CategoryResponseDTO> Categories { get; set; } = new List<CategoryResponseDTO>();
        public double AverageRating { get; set; }
        public int RatingsCount { get; set; }
        public string ImageUrl { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// DTO para recibir los detalles de un paso de una receta.s
    /// </summary>
    public class RecipeStepResponseDTO
    {
        public int StepNumber { get; set; }
        public string Instruction { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }


    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    //     DTOs para ENVIAR datos a la API (para actualizar la receta)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------

    /// <summary>
    /// DTO para enviar las actualizaciones de una receta a la API (PUT).
    /// </summary>
    public class RecipeUpdateDTO
    {
        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public ICollection<RecipeStepCreateDTO> Steps { get; set; } = new List<RecipeStepCreateDTO>();
        public ICollection<int> CategoryIds { get; set; } = new List<int>();
        public IFormFile? Image { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// DTO para enviar la instrucción de un paso nuevo o modificado.
    /// Reutilizamos el DTO de creación porque tiene la misma estructura.
    /// </summary>
    public class RecipeStepCreateDTO
    {
        public string Instruction { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    //         DTOs Adicionales (ya deberían estar en tu proyecto)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------

    /// <summary>
    /// DTO ligero para listas (usado en la página principal y "Mis Recetas").
    /// </summary>
    public class RecipeSummaryDTO
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }

CookingSharp/WebApp/Handlers/AuthenticationHeaderHandler.cs
﻿using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using WebApp.Auth;
using WebApp.Services;

namespace WebApp.Handlers
{
    public class AuthenticationHeaderHandler : DelegatingHandler
    {
        private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;

        public AuthenticationHeaderHandler(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
        {
            _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
        }

        protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            using (var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope())
            {
                var localStorage = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ILocalStorageService>();

                if (request.Headers.Authorization == null)
                {
                    var token = await localStorage.GetItemAsync<string>("authToken");
                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(token))
                    {
                        request.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
                    }
                }
            }

            var response = await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);

            if (response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized)
            {
                using (var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope())
                {
                    var authStateProvider = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<CustomAuthStateProvider>();
                    var navigationManager = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<NavigationManager>();

                    await authStateProvider.MarkUserAsLoggedOut();
                    navigationManager.NavigateTo("/login");
                }
            }

            return response;
        }
    }
}

<MudTable T="AppealResponseDTO" ServerData="ServerReload"
          Dense="true" Hover="true" @ref="_table" Striped="true">

@code {
    private MudTable<AppealResponseDTO> _table = null!;
    private IEnumerable<AppealResponseDTO> _applications = new List<AppealResponseDTO>();

    private async Task<TableData<AppealResponseDTO>> ServerReload(TableState state, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        try
        {
            var response = await Http.GetFromJsonAsync<List<AppealResponseDTO>>("api/appeals/my-appeals", cancellationToken);
            _applications = response ?? new List<AppealResponseDTO>();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Error al cargar tus solicitudes: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            _applications = new List<AppealResponseDTO>();
        }
        return new TableData<AppealResponseDTO>() { TotalItems = _applications.Count(), Items = _applications };
    }

    private Color GetStatusColor(string status) => status.ToLower() switch
    {
        "approved" => Color.Success,
        "rejected" => Color.Error,
        "pending" => Color.Warning,
        _ => Color.Default
    };

    private async Task OpenCreateApplicationDialog()
    {
        var dialog = DialogService.Show<CreateAppealDialog>("Nueva Solicitud");
        var result = await dialog.Result;

        bool cancelled = false;
        if (result != null)
        {
            var t = result.GetType();
            var prop = t.GetProperty("Cancelled")
                   ?? t.GetProperty("Canceled")
                   ?? t.GetProperty("IsCancelled")
                   ?? t.GetProperty("IsCanceled");

            if (prop != null && prop.PropertyType == typeof(bool))
            {
                try
                {
                    cancelled = (bool?)prop.GetValue(result) ?? false;
                }
                catch
                {
                    cancelled = false;
                }
            }
        }

        if (!cancelled)
        {
            await _table.ReloadServerData();
        }
    }
}

CookingSharp/WebApp/Pages/CreateMenu.razor
﻿@page "/menus/create"
@using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations
@using WebApp.DTOs

<MudText Class="mb-4">Dale un nombre y una descripción a tu menú, luego selecciona las recetas que quieres incluir.</MudText>

<EditForm EditContext="@_editContext" OnValidSubmit="HandleValidSubmit">
    <DataAnnotationsValidator />
    <MudGrid Spacing="4">
        <MudItem xs="12">
            <MudCard Elevation="2">
                <MudCardContent>
                    <MudTextField @bind-Value="_model.Name" For="@(() => _model.Name)" Label="Nombre del Menú" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Immediate="true" />
                    <MudTextField @bind-Value="_model.Description" For="@(() => _model.Description)" Label="Descripción" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Lines="3" Class="mt-4" />
                </MudCardContent>
            </MudCard>
        </MudItem>

        <MudItem xs="12">
            <MudCard Elevation="2">
                <MudCardHeader>
                    <CardHeaderContent>
                        <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Selección de Recetas (Solo Publicadas)</MudText>

                </MudCardHeader>

                    <MudGrid Spacing="2">

                                @foreach (var category in _allCategories)
                                {
                                    <MudSelectItem T="int?" Value="@category.Id">@category.Name</MudSelectItem>
                                }
                            </MudSelect>
                        </MudItem>
                    </MudGrid>

                    <MudPaper Height="300px" Class="overflow-y-auto pa-2 mt-4 mud-border-solid mud-border-lines-default rounded-lg">

                            <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" />

@code {
    private MenuCreateModel _model = new();
    private EditContext _editContext = default!;
    private List<RecipeSummaryDTO> _allMyRecipes = new();
    private List<RecipeSummaryDTO> _filteredRecipes = new();
    private List<CategoryResponseDTO> _allCategories = new();
    private bool _isLoadingRecipes = true;

    private string _recipeNameFilter = "";
    private int? _selectedCategoryId = null;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _editContext = new EditContext(_model);
        _isLoadingRecipes = true;
        try
        {
            var recipesTask = Http.GetFromJsonAsync<List<RecipeSummaryDTO>>("api/recipes/my-recipes");
            var categoriesTask = Http.GetFromJsonAsync<List<CategoryResponseDTO>>("api/categories");

            await Task.WhenAll(recipesTask, categoriesTask);

            var allRecipesFromApi = recipesTask.Result ?? new();

            // --- AQUÍ ESTÁ EL CAMBIO ---
            // Filtramos la lista para quedarnos solo con las recetas publicadas.
            _allMyRecipes = allRecipesFromApi
                .Where(r => r.Status == "Published")
                .ToList();

            _allCategories = categoriesTask.Result ?? new();

            ApplyFilters();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Error cargando datos necesarios: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            _isLoadingRecipes = false;
        }
    }

    private void ApplyFilters()
    {
        IEnumerable<RecipeSummaryDTO> recipes = _allMyRecipes;

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_recipeNameFilter))
        {
            recipes = recipes.Where(r => r.Name.Contains(_recipeNameFilter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        }
        if (_selectedCategoryId.HasValue)
        {
            recipes = recipes.Where(r => r.Categories.Any(c => c.Id == _selectedCategoryId.Value));
        }

        _filteredRecipes = recipes.ToList();
    }
    
    // El checkbox sigue fallando, vamos a usar el enfoque del modelo de vista que es a prueba de balas.
    private void OnRecipeChecked(int recipeId, bool isChecked)
    {
        if (isChecked)
        {
            if (!_model.SelectedRecipeIds.Contains(recipeId))
            {
                _model.SelectedRecipeIds.Add(recipeId);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            _model.SelectedRecipeIds.Remove(recipeId);
        }
        _editContext.NotifyFieldChanged(new FieldIdentifier(_model, nameof(_model.SelectedRecipeIds)));
    }


    private void OnNameFilterChanged(string value)
    {
        _recipeNameFilter = value;
        ApplyFilters();
    }

    private void OnCategoryFilterChanged(int? value)
    {
        _selectedCategoryId = value;
        ApplyFilters();
    }

    private async Task HandleValidSubmit()
    {
        if (!_model.SelectedRecipeIds.Any())
        {
            Snackbar.Add("Debes seleccionar al menos una receta.", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }

        var dto = new MenuCreateUpdateDTO
        {
            Name = _model.Name,
            Description = _model.Description,
            RecipeIds = _model.SelectedRecipeIds
        };

        try
        {
            var response = await Http.PostAsJsonAsync("api/menus", dto);
            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                Snackbar.Add("Menú creado con éxito.", Severity.Success);
                NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/my-menus");
            }
            else
            {
                var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                Snackbar.Add($"Error al crear el menú: {error}", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Error de conexión: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
    }

    private void GoBack() => NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/my-menus");

    public class MenuCreateModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "El nombre del menú es obligatorio.")]
        public string Name { get; set; } = "";

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "La descripción es obligatoria.")]
        public string Description { get; set; } = "";

        [EnsureOneElement(ErrorMessage = "Debes seleccionar al menos una receta.")]
        public List<int> SelectedRecipeIds { get; set; } = new();
    }

    public class EnsureOneElementAttribute : ValidationAttribute
    {
        public override bool IsValid(object? value)
        {
            var list = value as System.Collections.IList;
            return list != null && list.Count > 0;
        }
    }
}

    private RecipeCreateModel _recipeModel = new();

    private List<CategoryResponseDTO> _availableCategories = new();

    private IBrowserFile? _imageFile;
    private string? _imageDataUrl;

        try
        {
            var categories = await Http.GetFromJsonAsync<List<CategoryResponseDTO>>("api/categories");

        }
    }
    private async Task OnFileSelected(InputFileChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        _imageDataUrl = null;
        _imageFile = e.File;

        if (_imageFile != null)
        {
            if (_imageFile.Size > 2_000_000) // Límite de 2MB
            {
                Snackbar.Add("La imagen es demasiado grande. El límite es 2MB.", Severity.Warning);
                _imageFile = null;
                return;
            }

            var format = "image/png";
            var resizedImage = await _imageFile.RequestImageFileAsync(format, 400, 400);
            var buffer = new byte[resizedImage.Size];
            await resizedImage.OpenReadStream().ReadAsync(buffer);
            _imageDataUrl = $"data:{format};base64,{Convert.ToBase64String(buffer)}";
            
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private void OnCategoryChecked(int categoryId, bool isChecked)
    {
        if (isChecked)
        {
            if (!_recipeModel.CategoryIds.Contains(categoryId))
            {
                _recipeModel.CategoryIds.Add(categoryId);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            _recipeModel.CategoryIds.Remove(categoryId);
        }

        _editContext.NotifyFieldChanged(new FieldIdentifier(_recipeModel, nameof(_recipeModel.CategoryIds)));
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private void AddStep()
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_newStep))
        {
            _recipeModel.Steps.Add(_newStep.Trim());
            _newStep = "";
            _editContext.NotifyFieldChanged(new FieldIdentifier(_recipeModel, nameof(_recipeModel.Steps)));
        }
    }

    private void HandleKeyDown(KeyboardEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.Key == "Enter")
        {
            AddStep();
        }
    }

    private void RemoveStep(string step)
    {
        _recipeModel.Steps.Remove(step);
        _editContext.NotifyFieldChanged(new FieldIdentifier(_recipeModel, nameof(_recipeModel.Steps)));
    }

   private async Task HandleValidSubmit()
{
    if (_recipeModel.CategoryIds.Count == 0)
    {
        Snackbar.Add("Debes seleccionar al menos una categoría.", Severity.Warning);
        return;
    }

    if (_recipeModel.Steps.Count == 0)
    {
        Snackbar.Add("La receta debe tener al menos un paso.", Severity.Warning);
        return;
    }

    using var content = new MultipartFormDataContent();

    content.Add(new StringContent(_recipeModel.Name), "Name");
    content.Add(new StringContent(_recipeModel.Description), "Description");

    foreach (var categoryId in _recipeModel.CategoryIds)
    {
        content.Add(new StringContent(categoryId.ToString()), "CategoryIds");
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < _recipeModel.Steps.Count; i++)
    {
        content.Add(new StringContent(_recipeModel.Steps[i]), $"Steps[{i}].Instruction");
    }

    if (_imageFile != null)
    {
        var fileContent = new StreamContent(_imageFile.OpenReadStream(_imageFile.Size));
        fileContent.Headers.ContentType = new System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeHeaderValue(_imageFile.ContentType);
        content.Add(fileContent, "Image", _imageFile.Name);
    }

    try
    {
        var token = await LocalStorage.GetItemAsync<string>("authToken");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(token))
        {
            Snackbar.Add("Error de autenticación: No se encontró el token. Por favor, inicie sesión de nuevo.", Severity.Error);
            return;
        }

        var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "api/recipes");
        request.Content = content;
        
        request.Headers.Authorization = new System.Net.Http.Headers.AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
        var response = await Http.SendAsync(request);

        if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("¡Receta creada con éxito!", Severity.Success);
            NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/my-recipes");
        }
        else
        {
            var errorContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
            Console.WriteLine($"[DEBUG] Contenido del error de la API: {errorContent}");
            Snackbar.Add($"Error al crear la receta: {errorContent}", Severity.Error);
        }
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"[DEBUG] Excepción capturada: {ex.ToString()}");
        Snackbar.Add($"Error de conexión: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
    }
}

    private void GoBack()
    {
        NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/recipes");
    }

    public class RecipeCreateModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "El nombre de la receta es obligatorio.")]
        [StringLength(150, ErrorMessage = "El nombre no puede exceder los 150 caracteres.")]
        public string Name { get; set; } = "";

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "La descripción es obligatoria.")]
        [StringLength(500, ErrorMessage = "La descripción no puede exceder los 500 caracteres.")]
        public string Description { get; set; } = "";

        public List<int> CategoryIds { get; set; } = new();
        public List<string> Steps { get; set; } = new();
    }
}

@code {
    [Parameter]
    public int RecipeId { get; set; }

    private RecipeEditModel? _recipeModel;
    private EditContext _editContext = default!;
    private List<CategoryResponseDTO> _availableCategories = new();
    private string _newStep = "";

    private string? _currentImageUrl;
    private string? _newImageDataUrl;
    private IBrowserFile? _newImageFile;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            var categoryTask = Http.GetFromJsonAsync<List<CategoryResponseDTO>>("api/categories");
            var recipeTask = Http.GetFromJsonAsync<RecipeResponseDTO>($"api/recipes/{RecipeId}");

            await Task.WhenAll(categoryTask, recipeTask);

            var recipeData = recipeTask.Result;
            _availableCategories = categoryTask.Result ?? new();

            if (recipeData != null)
            {
                _recipeModel = new RecipeEditModel
                {
                    Name = recipeData.Name,
                    Description = recipeData.Description,
                    CategoryIds = recipeData.Categories.Select(c => c.Id).ToList(),
                    Steps = recipeData.Steps.OrderBy(s => s.StepNumber).Select(s => s.Instruction).ToList(),
                    Status = recipeData.Status
                };
                _currentImageUrl = recipeData.ImageUrl;
                _editContext = new EditContext(_recipeModel);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Error al cargar la receta: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
    }
    
    private async Task OnFileSelected(InputFileChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        _newImageFile = e.File;
        if (_newImageFile != null)
        {
            if (_newImageFile.Size > 2_000_000) // 2MB limit
            {
                Snackbar.Add("La imagen es demasiado grande. El límite es 2MB.", Severity.Warning);
                _newImageFile = null;
                return;
            }
            
            var format = "image/png";
            var resizedImage = await _newImageFile.RequestImageFileAsync(format, 400, 400);
            var buffer = new byte[resizedImage.Size];
            await resizedImage.OpenReadStream().ReadAsync(buffer);
            _newImageDataUrl = $"data:{format};base64,{Convert.ToBase64String(buffer)}";
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private async Task HandleValidSubmit()
    {
        if (_recipeModel is null) return;
        
        if (_recipeModel.CategoryIds.Count == 0 || _recipeModel.Steps.Count == 0)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("Asegúrate de que la receta tenga al menos una categoría y un paso.", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }

        using var content = new MultipartFormDataContent();
        content.Add(new StringContent(_recipeModel.Name), "Name");
        content.Add(new StringContent(_recipeModel.Description), "Description");
        content.Add(new StringContent(_recipeModel.Status), "Status");

        foreach (var id in _recipeModel.CategoryIds) { content.Add(new StringContent(id.ToString()), "CategoryIds"); }
        for (int i = 0; i < _recipeModel.Steps.Count; i++) { content.Add(new StringContent(_recipeModel.Steps[i]), $"Steps[{i}].Instruction"); }

        if (_newImageFile != null)
        {
            var fileContent = new StreamContent(_newImageFile.OpenReadStream(_newImageFile.Size));
            fileContent.Headers.ContentType = new System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeHeaderValue(_newImageFile.ContentType);
            content.Add(fileContent, "Image", _newImageFile.Name);
        }

        try
        {
            var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Put, $"api/recipes/{RecipeId}") { Content = content };
            var response = await Http.SendAsync(request);

            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                Snackbar.Add("Receta actualizada con éxito.", Severity.Success);
                NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/my-recipes");
            }
            else
            {
                var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                Snackbar.Add($"Error al actualizar la receta: {error}", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Error de conexión: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
    }

    private void GoBack() => NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/my-recipes");

    #region Clases de Modelo y Métodos de Ayuda
    public class RecipeEditModel
    {
        [Required] public string Name { get; set; } = "";
        [Required] public string Description { get; set; } = "";
        public List<int> CategoryIds { get; set; } = new();
        public List<string> Steps { get; set; } = new();
        public string Status { get; set; } = "";
    }

    private void OnCategoryChecked(int categoryId, bool isChecked)
    {
        if (_recipeModel is null) return;
        if (isChecked) { if (!_recipeModel.CategoryIds.Contains(categoryId)) _recipeModel.CategoryIds.Add(categoryId); }
        else { _recipeModel.CategoryIds.Remove(categoryId); }
        _editContext.NotifyFieldChanged(new FieldIdentifier(_recipeModel, nameof(_recipeModel.CategoryIds)));
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private void AddStep()
    {
        if (_recipeModel is null) return;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_newStep))
        {
            _recipeModel.Steps.Add(_newStep.Trim());
            _newStep = "";
            _editContext.NotifyFieldChanged(new FieldIdentifier(_recipeModel, nameof(_recipeModel.Steps)));
        }
    }
    
    private void HandleKeyDown(KeyboardEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.Key == "Enter")
        {
            AddStep();
        }
    }

    private void RemoveStep(string step)
    {
        if (_recipeModel is null) return;
        _recipeModel.Steps.Remove(step);
        _editContext.NotifyFieldChanged(new FieldIdentifier(_recipeModel, nameof(_recipeModel.Steps)));
    }
    #endregion
}

        </MudCardHeader>

                @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_errorMessage))
                {
                    <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Class="mb-3">@_errorMessage</MudAlert>
                }

                <MudButton ButtonType="ButtonType.Submit" Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" FullWidth="true" Size="Size.Large" Disabled="@_isSubmitting">
                    @if (_isSubmitting)
                    {
                        <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Small" />
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <span>Iniciar Sesión</span>
                    }
                </MudButton>
            </EditForm>
        </MudCardContent>
        <MudCardActions Class="d-flex justify-center pb-4">
            <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
                ¿No tienes cuenta? <MudLink Href="/register">Regístrate aquí</MudLink>
            </MudText>
        </MudCardActions>
    </MudCard>
</MudContainer>

@code {
    private readonly UserLoginDTO _model = new();
    private bool _isSubmitting = false;
    private string? _errorMessage;

    private async Task HandleLogin()
    {
        _isSubmitting = true;
        _errorMessage = null;
        try
        {
            var response = await Http.PostAsJsonAsync("api/auth/login", _model);

            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<LoginResponseDTO>();
                if (result != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(result.Token))
                {
                    var customAuthStateProvider = (CustomAuthStateProvider)AuthStateProvider;
                    customAuthStateProvider.MarkUserAsAuthenticated(result.Token);

                    NavManager.NavigateTo("/");
                    return;
                }
            }

            _errorMessage = "Email o contraseña incorrectos.";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _errorMessage = $"Ha ocurrido un error inesperado: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            _isSubmitting = false;
        }
    }
}

    [Parameter]
    public int MenuId { get; set; }

    private MenuResponseDTO? _menu;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()

    private async Task LoadMenuData()
    {

        {

        catch (Exception ex)

        finally
        {
            _isLoading = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task OnRatingChanged(int newRating)
    {
        var dto = new RatingCreateUpdateDTO { Stars = newRating };
        try
        {
            var response = await Http.PostAsJsonAsync($"api/menus/{MenuId}/ratings", dto);
            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                Snackbar.Add("¡Gracias por valorar este menú!", Severity.Success);
                await LoadMenuData();
                StateHasChanged();
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add("Error al enviar tu valoración.", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Error de conexión: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
    }
}

@using WebApp.DTOs

@inject ISnackbar Snackbar

<MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.ExtraLarge">

    <MudText Typo="Typo.h3" GutterBottom="true">Explorar Menús</MudText>

    <MudCard Elevation="3" Class="mb-6">

                <div class="d-flex align-center gap-2">
                    <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.FilterList" Color="Color.Primary" />
                    <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Filtros de Búsqueda</MudText>
                </div>
            </CardHeaderContent>
        </MudCardHeader>
        <MudCardContent>
            @if (_isLoading)
            {
                <MudSkeleton SkeletonType="SkeletonType.Rectangle" Height="60px" />
            }
            else
            {
                <MudGrid Spacing="3">
                    <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
                        <MudTextField T="string" Label="Buscar por nombre de menú" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Value="_nameFilter" ValueChanged="OnNameFilterChanged" Adornment="Adornment.Start" AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Search" DebounceInterval="300" />
                    </MudItem>
                    <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
                        <MudTextField T="string" Label="Buscar por creador" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Value="_authorFilter" ValueChanged="OnAuthorFilterChanged" Adornment="Adornment.Start" AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Person" DebounceInterval="300" />
                    </MudItem>
                </MudGrid>
            }
        </MudCardContent>
    </MudCard>

    <MudDivider Class="my-6" />

    @if (_isLoading)
    {
        <div class="d-flex justify-center mt-6">
            <MudProgressCircular Color="Color.Primary" Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Large" />
        </div>
    }
    else if (!_filteredMenus.Any())
    {
        <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Info" Class="mt-6" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Info">
            No se encontraron menús que coincidan con los filtros aplicados.
        </MudAlert>
    }
    else
    {
        <MudGrid Spacing="4">
            @foreach (var menu in _filteredMenus)
            {
                <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4" lg="3">
                    <MenuCard Menu="menu" />
                </MudItem>
            }
        </MudGrid>
    }
</MudContainer>

@code {
    private List<MenuSummaryDTO>? _allMenus;
    private List<MenuSummaryDTO> _filteredMenus = new();

    private string _nameFilter = "";
    private string _authorFilter = "";
    private bool _isLoading = true;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _isLoading = true;
        try
        {
            _allMenus = await Http.GetFromJsonAsync<List<MenuSummaryDTO>>("api/menus/summaries");
            ApplyFilters();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Error al cargar los menús: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            _allMenus = new List<MenuSummaryDTO>();
        }
        finally
        {
            _isLoading = false;
        }
    }

    private void ApplyFilters()
    {
        if (_allMenus == null)
        {
            _filteredMenus = new List<MenuSummaryDTO>();
            return;
        }

        IEnumerable<MenuSummaryDTO> menus = _allMenus;

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_nameFilter))
        {
            menus = menus.Where(m => m.Name.Contains(_nameFilter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_authorFilter))
        {
            menus = menus.Where(m => m.AuthorName.Contains(_authorFilter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        }

        _filteredMenus = menus.ToList();
    }

    private void OnNameFilterChanged(string value)
    {
        _nameFilter = value;
        ApplyFilters();
    }

    private void OnAuthorFilterChanged(string value)
    {
        _authorFilter = value;
        ApplyFilters();
    }
}

@code {
    private MudTable<RecipeResponseDTO> _table;
    private IEnumerable<RecipeResponseDTO> _recipes = new List<RecipeResponseDTO>();
    private int _totalItems;

    private async Task<TableData<RecipeResponseDTO>> ServerReload(TableState state, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        try
        {
            var response = await Http.GetFromJsonAsync<List<RecipeResponseDTO>>("api/recipes/my-recipes", cancellationToken);
            _recipes = response ?? new List<RecipeResponseDTO>();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Error al cargar tus recetas: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            _recipes = new List<RecipeResponseDTO>();
        }

        _totalItems = _recipes.Count();
        return new TableData<RecipeResponseDTO>() { TotalItems = _totalItems, Items = _recipes };
    }

    private Color GetStatusColor(string status) => status switch
    {
        "Published" => Color.Success,
        "Draft" => Color.Default,
        "Blocked" => Color.Error,
        _ => Color.Info
    };

    private void EditRecipe(int recipeId)
    {
        NavigationManager.NavigateTo($"/recipes/edit/{recipeId}");
    }

    private async Task PublishRecipe(RecipeResponseDTO recipe)
    {
        bool? result = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
            "Confirmar Publicación", 
            (MarkupString)$"¿Estás seguro de que quieres publicar la receta <strong>' {recipe.Name} '</strong> ? Una vez publicada, será visible para todos.",
            yesText: "Publicar", 
            cancelText: "Cancelar");
        
        if (result == true)
        {
            var dto = new { Status = "Published" };
            try
            {
                var response = await Http.PatchAsJsonAsync($"api/recipes/{recipe.Id}/status", dto);
                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Snackbar.Add("¡Receta publicada con éxito!", Severity.Success);
                    await _table.ReloadServerData();
                }
                else
                {
                    Snackbar.Add("Error al publicar la receta.", Severity.Error);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Snackbar.Add($"Error de conexión: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
    }
    private async Task DeleteRecipe(RecipeResponseDTO recipe)
    {
        bool? result = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
            "Confirmar Eliminación", 
            (MarkupString)$"¿Estás seguro de que deseas eliminar la receta <strong>' {recipe.Name} '</strong> ?",
            yesText: "Eliminar",
            cancelText: "Cancelar");
        
        if (result == true)
        {
            try
            {
                var response = await Http.DeleteAsync($"api/recipes/{recipe.Id}");
                
                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    Snackbar.Add("Receta eliminada con éxito.", Severity.Success);
                    await _table.ReloadServerData();
                }
                else
                {
                    var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    Snackbar.Add($"Error al eliminar la receta: {error}", Severity.Error);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Snackbar.Add($"Error de conexión: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
    }
}

CookingSharp/WebApp/Pages/RecipeDetail.razor

@code {
    [Parameter]
    public int RecipeId { get; set; }

    private RecipeResponseDTO? _recipe;
    private List<CommentResponseDTO> _comments = new();
    
    private string _newCommentText = "";
    private bool _isLoading = true;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadAllData();
    }

    private async Task LoadAllData()
    {
        _isLoading = true;
        try
        {
            var recipeTask = LoadRecipeAsync();
            var commentsTask = LoadCommentsAsync();

            await Task.WhenAll(recipeTask, commentsTask);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Error al cargar los detalles de la receta: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            _isLoading = false;
        }
    }
    
    private async Task LoadRecipeAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            _recipe = await Http.GetFromJsonAsync<RecipeResponseDTO>($"api/recipes/{RecipeId}");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"No se pudo cargar la receta: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            _recipe = null;
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadCommentsAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            _comments = await Http.GetFromJsonAsync<List<CommentResponseDTO>>($"api/recipes/{RecipeId}/comments") ?? new();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"No se pudieron cargar los comentarios: {ex.Message}", Severity.Warning);
        }
    }

    private async Task SubmitRating(int ratingValue)
    {
        var authState = await AuthStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
        var user = authState.User;
        if (user.Identity == null || !user.Identity.IsAuthenticated)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("Debe iniciar sesión para poder valorar.", Severity.Info);
            return;
        }

        var dto = new RatingCreateUpdateDTO { Stars = ratingValue };
        try
        {
            var response = await Http.PostAsJsonAsync($"api/recipes/{RecipeId}/ratings", dto);
            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                Snackbar.Add("¡Gracias por tu valoración!", Severity.Success);
                await LoadRecipeAsync();
                StateHasChanged();
            }
            else
            {
                var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                Snackbar.Add($"Error al enviar la valoración: {error}", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Error de conexión: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
    }

    private async Task SubmitComment()
    {
        var authState = await AuthStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
        var user = authState.User;

        if (user.Identity == null || !user.Identity.IsAuthenticated)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("Debe iniciar sesión para poder comentar.", Severity.Info);
            return;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_newCommentText)) return;

        var dto = new CommentCreateDTO { Text = _newCommentText };
        try
        {
            var response = await Http.PostAsJsonAsync($"api/recipes/{RecipeId}/comments", dto);
            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                _newCommentText = "";
                Snackbar.Add("Comentario añadido.", Severity.Success);
                await LoadCommentsAsync(); 
                StateHasChanged();
            }
            else
            {
                var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                Snackbar.Add($"Error al enviar el comentario: {error}", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Error de conexión: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
    }
}

@code {
    private List<RecipeSummaryDTO>? _allRecipes;
    private List<RecipeSummaryDTO> _filteredRecipes = new();
    private List<CategoryResponseDTO>? _allCategories;

    private string nameFilter = "";
    private string creatorFilter = "";
    private int? selectedCategoryId = null;
    private bool _isLoading = true;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        _isLoading = true;
        try
        {
            _allCategories = await Http.GetFromJsonAsync<List<CategoryResponseDTO>>("api/categories");
            _allRecipes = await Http.GetFromJsonAsync<List<RecipeSummaryDTO>>("api/recipes/summaries");
            ApplyFilters();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Error al cargar los datos: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            _allRecipes = new List<RecipeSummaryDTO>();
            _allCategories = new List<CategoryResponseDTO>();
        }
        finally
        {
            _isLoading = false;
        }
    }

    private void ApplyFilters()
    {
        if (_allRecipes == null)
        {
            _filteredRecipes = new List<RecipeSummaryDTO>();
            return;
        }

        IEnumerable<RecipeSummaryDTO> recipes = _allRecipes;

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(nameFilter))
        {
            recipes = recipes.Where(r => r.Name.Contains(nameFilter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(creatorFilter))
        {
            recipes = recipes.Where(r => r.AuthorName.Contains(creatorFilter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        }

        if (selectedCategoryId.HasValue)
        {
            recipes = recipes.Where(r => r.Categories.Any(c => c.Id == selectedCategoryId.Value));
        }

        _filteredRecipes = recipes.ToList();
    }

    private void OnNameFilterChanged(string value)
    {
        nameFilter = value;
        ApplyFilters();
    }

    private void OnCreatorFilterChanged(string value)
    {
        creatorFilter = value;
        ApplyFilters();
    }

    private void OnCategoryFilterChanged(int? value)
    {
        selectedCategoryId = value;
        ApplyFilters();
    }
}

    private readonly UserCreateDTO _model = new();
    private bool _isSubmitting = false;
    private string? _errorMessage;

    private async Task HandleRegistration()
    {
        _isSubmitting = true;
        _errorMessage = null;

        try
        {
            // Hacemos la llamada POST a nuestra API
            var response = await Http.PostAsJsonAsync("api/auth/register", _model);

            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                // Si el registro es exitoso, redirigimos al login
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/login");
            }
            else
            {
                // Si la API devuelve un error (ej. email ya existe), lo mostramos
                _errorMessage = $"Error en el registro: {await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()}";
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _errorMessage = $"Ha ocurrido un error inesperado: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            _isSubmitting = false;
        }
    }
}

        Task SetItemAsync<T>(string key, T value);
        Task RemoveItemAsync(string key);
    }

CookingSharp/WebApp/Services/LocalStorageService.cs
﻿using Microsoft.JSInterop;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace WebApp.Services
{
    public class LocalStorageService : ILocalStorageService
    {
        private readonly IJSRuntime _jsRuntime;

        public LocalStorageService(IJSRuntime jsRuntime)
        {
            _jsRuntime = jsRuntime;
        }

        public async Task<T> GetItemAsync<T>(string key)
        {
            var json = await _jsRuntime.InvokeAsync<string>("localStorage.getItem", key);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(json))
                return default;

            return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(json);
        }

        public async Task SetItemAsync<T>(string key, T value)
        {
            await _jsRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync("localStorage.setItem", key, JsonSerializer.Serialize(value));
        }

        public async Task RemoveItemAsync(string key)
        {
            await _jsRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync("localStorage.removeItem", key);
        }
    }
}

CookingSharp/WebApp/Services/UserStateService.cs
﻿using System.Security.Claims;
using WebApp.DTOs;

public class UserStateService
{
    public UserResponseDTO CurrentUser { get; private set; }

    public void SetUser(ClaimsPrincipal user)
    {
        if (user.Identity.IsAuthenticated)
        {
            CurrentUser = new UserResponseDTO
            {
                Id = int.Parse(user.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value ?? "0"),
                Email = user.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.Email)?.Value,
                Role = user.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.Role)?.Value
            };
        }
        else
        {
            CurrentUser = null;
        }
    }
}

CookingSharp/WebApp/Shared/TopAppBar.razor
﻿@* Asumo que este archivo está en la carpeta Shared *@
@implements IDisposable
@using WebApp.Auth
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization
@using System.Security.Claims
@using System.Net.Http.Json
@using System.Net.Http.Headers
@using WebApp.DTOs
@using WebApp.Services

@inject NavigationManager NavigationManager
@inject AuthenticationStateProvider AuthenticationStateProvider
@inject HttpClient Http
@inject ILocalStorageService LocalStorage
@inject UserStateService UserState


<MudAppBar Elevation="1">
    <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Menu" Color="Color.Inherit" Edge="Edge.Start" OnClick="@(() => OnDrawerToggle.InvokeAsync())" />
    <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="ml-4">Cooking#</MudText>
    <MudSpacer />
    
    <AuthorizeView>
        <Authorized>
            <MudText Typo="Typo.body1">Hola, @_displayName</MudText>
            <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Logout" Color="Color.Inherit" OnClick="Logout" Class="ml-2" />
        </Authorized>
        <NotAuthorized>
            <MudButton Href="/login" Color="Color.Inherit">Login</MudButton>
        </NotAuthorized>
    </AuthorizeView>
</MudAppBar>

@code {
    [Parameter]
    public EventCallback OnDrawerToggle { get; set; }

    private string? _displayName;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        AuthenticationStateProvider.AuthenticationStateChanged += AuthStateChanged;
        await LoadDisplayNameAsync();
    }

    private async void AuthStateChanged(Task<AuthenticationState> authStateTask)
    {
        await InvokeAsync(async () =>
        {
            await LoadDisplayNameAsync();
            StateHasChanged();
        });
    }

    private async Task LoadDisplayNameAsync()
    {
        _displayName = "Usuario";

        var authState = await AuthenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
        var user = authState.User;

        if (user.Identity?.IsAuthenticated != true)
        {
            _displayName = null;
            return;
        }

        _displayName = user.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.Name)?.Value
                       ?? user.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.Email)?.Value
                       ?? "Usuario";
    }

    private async Task Logout()
    {
        var customAuthStateProvider = (CustomAuthStateProvider)AuthenticationStateProvider;
        await customAuthStateProvider.MarkUserAsLoggedOut();
        NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/login");
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        AuthenticationStateProvider.AuthenticationStateChanged -= AuthStateChanged;
    }
}

CookingSharp/WebApp/Shared/Dialog/CreateAppealDialog.razor
﻿@using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations
@using WebApp.DTOs
@using MudBlazor
@inject HttpClient Http
@inject ISnackbar Snackbar

<MudDialog>
    <TitleContent>
        <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">Solicitud para ser Chef</MudText>
    </TitleContent>
    <DialogContent>
        <MudText Class="mb-4">Explica por qué te gustaría convertirte en Chef. Tu solicitud será revisada por un administrador.</MudText>
        <EditForm Model="@_model" OnValidSubmit="Submit">
            <DataAnnotationsValidator />
            <MudTextField @bind-Value="_model.Description"
                          For="@(() => _model.Description)"
                          Label="Tu motivación"
                          Variant="Variant.Outlined"
                          Lines="5" />
        </EditForm>
    </DialogContent>
    <DialogActions>
        <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancelar</MudButton>
        <MudButton Color="Color.Primary" Variant="Variant.Filled" OnClick="Submit" Disabled="@_isSubmitting">
            @if (_isSubmitting)
            {
                <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" Size="Size.Small" />
            }
            else
            {
                <span>Enviar Solicitud</span>
            }
        </MudButton>
    </DialogActions>
</MudDialog>

@code {
    [CascadingParameter]
    object? DialogInstance { get; set; }

    private AppealCreateModel _model = new();
    private bool _isSubmitting = false;

    private async Task Submit()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_model.Description))
        {
            Snackbar.Add("La descripción no puede estar vacía.", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }

        _isSubmitting = true;

        var dto = new AppealCreateDTO { Description = _model.Description };

        try
        {
            var response = await Http.PostAsJsonAsync("api/appeals", dto);
            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                Snackbar.Add("Solicitud enviada con éxito.", Severity.Success);

                try
                {
                    if (DialogInstance != null)
                    {
                        var t = DialogInstance.GetType();
                        var cancel = t.GetMethod("Cancel", System.Type.EmptyTypes);
                        if (cancel != null)
                        {
                            cancel.Invoke(DialogInstance, null);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            var closeNoArg = t.GetMethod("Close", System.Type.EmptyTypes);
                            if (closeNoArg != null)
                                closeNoArg.Invoke(DialogInstance, null);
                            else
                            {
                                var closeWithArg = t.GetMethod("Close", new[] { typeof(object) });
                                if (closeWithArg != null)
                                    closeWithArg.Invoke(DialogInstance, new object[] { null });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch
                {
                }
            }
            else
            {
                var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                Snackbar.Add($"Error al enviar la solicitud: {error}", Severity.Error);
                _isSubmitting = false;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Error de conexión: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            _isSubmitting = false;
        }
    }

    void Cancel()
    {
        try
        {
            DialogInstance?.GetType().GetMethod("Cancel", System.Type.EmptyTypes)?.Invoke(DialogInstance, null);
        }
        catch
        {
        }
    }

    public class AppealCreateModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Debes escribir una motivación.")]
        [StringLength(1000, ErrorMessage = "La descripción no puede exceder los 1000 caracteres.")]
        public string Description { get; set; } = "";
    }
}
